title: After the Tenno Sho (Spring): Someone to Learn From

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (I didn't even come close! How is she so much better than me?!)

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ryan has won the spring shield! What an incredible display of might from the Mejiro family!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Way to go, Ryan! I bet the whole Mejiro family is just beaming with pride right now!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Ahh… She's practically shaking with joy! I wonder what she's going to say…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: McQueen isn't the only runner in the Mejiro family! And at the Takarazuka Kinen, I, Mejiro Ryan, will show you once again that I'm not to be ignored!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I hope you'll all keep cheering for me!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (If I was standing there victorious right now, I'd probably just scream with joy.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (But not Ryan… She prioritized thanking her fans over celebrating her own victory.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …Now that's someone who's lived shouldering expectations. That's what separates me and her…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I've made up my mind! At the Takarazuka Kinen, that's gonna be me!
